page_title: LEC 1-0 VER | Lecce v Verona 29/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' One of the players from Lecce times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+4' Lecce quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+3' Tete Morente (Lecce) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

89' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Simone Perilli!
87' Dani Silva (Verona) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
87' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Verona.
86' Substitution. Ante Rebic (Lecce) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Nikola Krstovic walks off.
86' Substitution. Lassana Coulibaly makes way for Remi Oudin (Lecce).
84' Paolo Zanetti has decided to make a change. Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) replaces Flavius Daniliuc.
84' Substitution. Tomas Suslov makes his way off the pitch and Dani Silva (Verona) comes on as his replacement.
82' Was it necessary? Reda Belahyane (Verona) is shown a second yellow card for dissent and has to leave the pitch. Maurizio Mariani had no hesitation in issuing a red card!
77' Tomas Suslov (Verona) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Wladimiro Falcone gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
76' Simone Perilli displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
73' The substitution has been made. Tete Morente (Lecce) has replaced Lameck Banda.
72' Lameck Banda (Lecce) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
70' Tomas Suslov (Verona) was too forceful with his tackle and Maurizio Mariani interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Lecce.
65' The referee allows time for a substitution. Darko Lazovic will be replaced by Domagoj Bradaric (Verona).
65' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Suat Serdar as he is replaced by Mathis Lambourde (Verona).
64' The resulting set piece from Lecce is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
63' Luca Gotti prepares a substitution. Hamza Rafia is replaced by Balthazar Pierret (Lecce).
63' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Frederic Guilbert.
62' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Antonino Gallo (Lecce), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
60' Tomas Suslov (Verona) fails to convert a close-range free kick as he sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
59' Verona are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
59' Lameck Banda (Lecce) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
56' What was Suat Serdar (Verona) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
53' Casper Tengstedt goes off the pitch and Daniel Mosquera (Verona) comes on.
53' Referee Maurizio Mariani points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) goes wild in celebration.
52' The Lecce players joy may have been justified, because referee Maurizio Mariani is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
51' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) has a goal ruled out for offside!
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Simone Perilli was alert and made a comfortable save.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Lecce are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
43' Tomas Suslov (Verona) is able to continue to play.
43' Tomas Suslov (Verona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
42' A decent effort by Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) from a close-range free kick! His attempt flies narrowly over the crossbar.
41' A free kick on the edge of the box for Lecce. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
40' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) is being sent off by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier!
37' A goal, which was scored by Patrick Dorgu (Lecce), was disallowed due to offside.
32' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
30' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) and Hamza Rafia attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
27' Lecce are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
26' Reda Belahyane (Verona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Maurizio Mariani had an easy-decision to make.
26' Ondrej Duda (Verona) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
23' Ondrej Duda (Verona) takes the corner but it's cleared.
21' The Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Maurizio Mariani rules it out for a foul.
20' The ball goes behind for a corner. Lecce will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
20' Lecce couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Simone Perilli (Verona) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
18' Suat Serdar (Verona) plays a one-two with Tomas Suslov, but the move breaks down.

15' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He planted a header against the left post and it glanced away off it.
15' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Lecce out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
14' Ondrej Duda (Verona) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
14' Ondrej Duda (Verona) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
13' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
12' Suat Serdar (Verona) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
9' One of the Lecce players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
7' The ball is cleared after Tomas Suslov (Verona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
3' Tomas Suslov (Verona) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Verona will kick the game off.
Maurizio Mariani was nominated as the referee for this game.
